text_block_list.text:
Training for mock race had begun!
Though time remained short.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: ――Haah, haah, haah, haah……!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Yes, stamina lasts longer than when I started……!
Leg muscles growing stronger too……

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Yes!

Satono Crown worked hard making up missed days.
Talented from start, gradually growing even stronger……

Then, day finally arrived……
Raining since morning.

text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Coming down hard, huh? Looks rough.
Rumored one-on-one between Duramente and Satono Crown, but……

text_block_list.name: Experienced Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Turf like this might be unfortunate for Satono Crown.
She was raised sheltered after all……

text_block_list.name: Experienced Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Busy with family business too, worry she hasn't adjusted.
Unfortunate, but weather may hold her back.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: ……Trainer. Do you also believe my chances slim?

Little time existed, yet with sheer focus,
she completed custom training menu to perfection.

Besides, rain wasn't headwind for her—tailwind.
Understood that day I met her.

What captivated me at first sight was sharp acceleration on heavy turf.
Satono Crown was truly "Track Virtuoso"……!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Now that you mention it, perhaps so. Fufu……!

Days spent together made it clear.
Satono Crown displays true brilliance amidst adversity……!
choice_data_list: You're more fired up than usual!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Indeed……! That is who I am.
Exactly kind of adversity I must overcome!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Let's place faith in that! In you, and your faith in me.
I have full confidence!

And so race started……!
Uma Musume sprinted across rain-drenched heavy track.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Haah…… Haah…………!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: (Yes, good…… all within expectations……!)

text_block_list.name: Event Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Satono Crown and Duramente both hold back near rear!
Observing each other while conserving stamina……!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
……Seems you prepared in time.
However…… Hmph――!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: (Here it comes……!)

text_block_list.name: Event Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Final stretch! Rear runners begin pushing forward!
Pushing forward! Duramente unleashes terrifying acceleration―――!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: (Fast……! Gh……!)

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
――! Yes……! All right!
Matter not how formidable my opponents are……!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: ――I will turn this around without fail!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaaaa――――!

text_block_list.name: Event Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Across the goal! Results…… are decided!
First place, Duramente! Second place, Satono Crown by a head……!

text_block_list.name: Experienced Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
A head? To push Duramente that far.
Possesses surprising power, doesn't she……?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Haah, haah, haah……
Kh……!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
A hair's breadth, huh……?
Yet…… means I caught up to you.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ……! Yeah……

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Next time…… I win decisively.
Twinkle Series will be our battlefield.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: ……I expect nothing less!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Crown-chan, you were so close……!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Step short, but gave everything.
Thanks for cheering!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Watching you was thrilling.
Makes me feel I cannot just wait around……!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I want to become strong like Crown-chan too……!
Debut soon, and seize…… a G1 victory!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, me too!
With this momentum, I will claim G1 without fail……!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Not just for Satono family, but for Dia too.
Debuting first, so I shall lead way!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Debut? Huh?
Were you not still searching for trainer?

text_block_list.name: Experienced Trainer A
text_block_list.text: Pardon me, Satono Crown-san! May we speak?

text_block_list.name: Experienced Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Thought about this since previous mock race, seeing this convinced me.
I want to scout you……!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Honored…… however, apologies.
I already decided――

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: On person who guided me this far.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
To weave extraordinary magic,
first-rate partner is essential.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
One I place trust in is you.
For Satono family's long-held wish, I want to run alongside you……!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: You will sign formal contract with me, correct?

Overjoyed, shook hands with Satono Crown.
Melancholy rainclouds now showed silver lining.
